summary.nextAction: Replace mock endpoint with the production receipt adapter only after scoped credentials and owner write policy are approved.

assertions.label: Fixture path is public
assertions.expected: Only relative public fixture paths are accepted.

assertions.label: Variant gates are deterministic
assertions.expected: Ready, Review, and Blocked variants must be represented before sync payload generation.

assertions.label: Replay command is non-mutating
assertions.expected: Contract replay must include dry-run and no-write flags.

assertions.label: Output shape is known
assertions.expected: Receipt draft and sync payload paths must be known before external sync is attempted.

assertions.label: External endpoint is mocked
assertions.expected: Production sync requires an asset platform or publish-ledger adapter endpoint.

assertions.label: Production credential is absent
assertions.expected: Production replay needs a scoped write credential owned by the platform service.
assertions.actual: No credential is loaded in the public portfolio package.

recoveryPlan: Run contract replay against the Review variants with production endpoint disabled.
Ask adapter owner to approve endpoint, credential scope, and payload comment template.
Retry only the held payloads after contract assertions pass; blocked variants require owner fixture changes first.
guardrails: No external task, comment, publish receipt, or engine package state is mutated by this fixture.
Blocked variants produce skipped payloads and recovery incidents instead of success receipts.
Production credentials are intentionally absent from the public package.
